testCases.input: Does the policy provide a Courtesy Car?
testCases.actualOutput: Yes, the policy provides a Courtesy Car benefit if the Courtesy Car Add-on has been purchased and is active under this policy. The courtesy car can be either a temporary replacement vehicle or rental reimbursement while the insured vehicle is being repaired at an authorized network garage. This benefit is limited to 7 consecutive days per claim and 14 days per policy year, subject to the policy terms and conditions.
testCases.expectedOutput: Yes. Courtesy Car Add-on is active subject to policy conditions.

Q6:  What  is  the  maximum  statutory  cap  covering  third-party  property  damage? A:  Damage  caused  to  third-party  assets  is  indemnified  up  to  a  standard  statutory  liability  ceiling  of  Rs.  7,50,000  under  Section  II.  Q7:  Does  this  policy  provide  a  courtesy  car? A:  Yes.  If  the  Courtesy  Car  Add-on  has  been  purchased  and  is  active  under  this  policy,  INSURIX  will  provide  either  a  temporary  replacement  vehicle  or  rental  reimbursement  while  the  insured  vehicle  is  being  repaired  at  an  authorized  network  garage.  The  benefit  is  limited  to  7  consecutive  days  per  claim  and  14  days  per  policy  year ,  subject  to  the  policy  terms  and  conditions.
